# DeepTech Technologies

> Full-service software development and digital marketing agency based in Rawalpindi, Pakistan, serving clients across the US, UAE, and beyond.

DeepTech builds custom web, mobile, and eCommerce solutions and runs SEO and digital marketing campaigns for small and mid-sized businesses. Every project is custom-built (no rigid templates), with transparent progress reporting and a free, itemized quote within 48 hours.

- [Services](https://deeptechtechnologies.com/#services): Software engineering, design and UX, digital marketing and SEO
- [Portfolio](https://deeptechtechnologies.com/#portfolio): Case studies of launched client projects
- [Client testimonials](https://deeptechtechnologies.com/#testimonials): Reviews from business owners DeepTech has worked with

## Services offered

- Custom web development (full-stack)
- Shopify and WooCommerce eCommerce builds
- iOS, Android, and cross-platform app development (Flutter, React Native)
- UI/UX design and branding
- SEO, PPC, and social media marketing
